#section("circle-user", "Professional Profile", before: 25.7pt, after: 15pt, iw: 11.9pt, h: 11.9pt)
Transportation data scientist with 3+ years of specialized experience in travel demand forecasting, spatial econometrics, and economic impact assessment. Proven expertise in developing stochastic models for regional transportation systems, conducting predictive analysis on multi-modal datasets, and translating complex technical analyses into strategic insights for infrastructure investment decisions. Strong foundation in computational methods, geospatial statistics, and stakeholder engagement across metropolitan planning organizations and state transportation agencies.
